{{Quote|Politics is for the brass and the movers and shakers, I just blow up what they tell me to.|Corgan Sturm|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Brass''' was an artificial metal, a [[Copper/Legends|copper]]-[[Zinc/Legends|zinc]] alloy that contained up to 40% zinc. Its [[Color/Legends|color]] ranged from yellow to red. Brass not only resisted corrosion, but it was also a good conductor of electricity and heat. It was used for bed frames, etching, jewelry, and stamping.<ref name="DW">''[[Star Wars: DroidWorks]]''</ref> Fancy objects made of brass ranged from plates<ref name="DSB">[[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']]</ref> to sliding doors.<ref name="TPST">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref> The first models of [[Lovolan]]'s [[R-10 household droid]] were decorated with antique brass fittings; later, more subdued, modules, only had a decorative brass rail. The [[TT-8L/XSS]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was plating in antique brass. Both droids saw extensive use on the resort [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Hesperidium/Legends|Hesperidium]].<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

"Brass" was also a term for commanding officers.
